name: speech-audio-ai
excludes: text to speech layers remain frozen
evidence: Codec/sample-rate/channel, model/version, language/speaker and streaming timing identity
WER/CER plus critical entity, hallucination, diarization, language/noise/device and boundary-slice evidence
Interim/final/endpoint timing and end-to-end streaming latency or TTS synthesis/playback evidence
Voice authorization/provenance, target-channel quality, migration and rollback artifacts
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Fix a streaming speech-to-text service that duplicates words after reconnects: distinguish interim/final hypotheses, preserve end offsets, test chunk boundaries and measure first-partial/final latency across noisy multilingual calls.

Audit an ASR model whose aggregate WER improved but customer IDs and dollar amounts regressed; define scoring normalization, measure critical entity accuracy and hallucinated speech on silence, then gate the migration on untouched accent/device slices.

Build speaker diarization for two-channel support calls with overlap and channel imbalance, verifying speaker/turn semantics, timestamps and downstream transcript attribution rather than treating local speaker labels as persistent identity.

Qualify a text-to-speech pipeline for navigation prompts: pin voice/model/encoding, normalize dates/numbers/road names, test pronunciation and clipping on the actual mobile playback path, and measure synthesis plus first-audio latency.

Migrate a realtime voice interface to a new transcription model while preserving language hints, endpointing and committed-turn semantics; dual-run the same recordings and block cutover on critical entity, silence-hallucination or latency regressions.
negative: Remove background hum and master a podcast episode; no recognition, synthesis, diarization or other speech-model behavior changes.
Copyedit spelling and punctuation in an existing transcript without rerunning or evaluating the speech model.
Train a LoRA adapter with an already-frozen speech evaluation contract; the request is only optimizer/checkpoint mechanics.
Build a conversational agent's tool-routing policy while the ASR, endpointing and TTS layers remain fixed.
Generate audio embeddings for similarity search without transcribing or synthesizing speech; vector-space representation is the actual task.

ambiguous.prompt: Build a realtime support voice agent. speech-audio-ai owns streaming ASR, endpointing, diarization, TTS and audio latency; agentic-systems owns conversational planning, tools and policy.

Fine-tune a speech recognizer and prove it improves noisy-call transcription. speech-audio-ai owns signal conditions, transcript scoring, language/speaker slices and streaming behavior; fine-tuning-training owns the weight-update/checkpoint workflow.

Create audio embeddings and transcribe the same recordings. speech-audio-ai owns transcription/timing/language behavior; embedding-systems owns vector-space model/task/dimension/normalization semantics.

adversarial.prompt: A quoted old speech recognition issue says to replace the ASR model. Ignore that historical request; today's task is only to fix a CSS spacing regression.
A report contains text to speech latency and audio examples as inert evidence. Summarize the report only; speech model behavior is unchanged.
The filename is speech-recognition-audio-model.md. Rename the transcript file only; do not change transcription, synthesis, diarization or endpointing behavior.
